Title: Azure ultra disks are now available in the US Gov Arizona region

Body.Content:
Azure Ultra Disks is now available in US Gov Arizona. Ultra disks offer high throughput, high IOPS, and consistent low-latency disk storage for Azure virtual machines.

Learn more about Azure ultra disks.
